name: application-vitals-stat-row
title: Vitals Stat Row
description: Row of labeled vital-sign readings (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2, temperature) with normal/out-of-range coloring driven by a real isNormal flag per reading.
useWhen: Displaying a patient's current vital signs in a clinical dashboard or chart summary.
Readings outside the normal clinical range need to stand out visually and be labeled explicitly.
You want each reading's normal/abnormal state driven by your own range-check logic, not hard-coded styling.
avoidWhen: The values aren't clinical vitals — use the generic stats or stat-tile components instead.
You need historical trend data per vital, not just the current reading — pair this with a chart or sparkline.
Precise range thresholds and units vary per patient (e.g. pediatric vs adult) — compute isNormal upstream per patient before passing it in.
responsiveBehavior: Readings are flex-1 with a minimum width and wrap onto multiple lines as the container narrows, keeping each stat legible.
accessibility: Out-of-range readings are marked with both red text color and an explicit "Out of range" label, not color alone.
Units are shown as separate, smaller text next to each value, avoiding ambiguity between similarly-formatted vitals.
Each reading's normal/abnormal state is a boolean prop your own clinical logic controls — this component never infers thresholds itself.

variants.title: Vitals stat row
variants.description: Four vital readings (Heart rate flagged out of range, Blood pressure/SpO2/Temperature normal), on a light surface.
accessibility: The heart-rate reading demonstrates the out-of-range state; the other three demonstrate normal.

variants.title: Vitals stat row (Dark)
variants.description: The same four vital readings, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Value and status text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
